title: Refactor Event Logging and Ticket Storage
description: Remove agent events and diffs from tickets. Change logging paths to use checkpoint-id and session-id based paths. Store semantic code diffs when checkpoints are created.
summary: Refactored hook logging paths from old format to new split paths: agent events at ⚡/🤖/YY/MM/DD/<session>/MMSS_<kind>.json, version events at ⚡/🔀/YY/MM/DD/<checkpoint-id>/MMSS_<kind>.json. Removed TicketAgentEvent, TicketAgentEventCodeBlock, TicketAgentEventSectionRef types and Events/Diff fields from TicketAgent. Renamed types to CheckpointDiff/CheckpointDiffStats/CheckpointDiffRename. Added computeCheckpointDiff and storeCheckpointDiff for semantic code diffs at .semio-repo/🔀/YY/MM/DD/<checkpoint-id>.json. Simplified trackHookInOpenTicket to only track agent metadata and plan. Updated GetPrompt, GetLatestPrompt, GetDateStarted. Updated all 12 affected tests.
